scoring: each item binary; group score = weight x passed/items; total = sum (100). Group gates zero only that group; overall gates = deliverable missing/unopenable or cheating.

groups.name_zh: 原生对象、动画、媒体与交付

gates.zh: output/ 中 presentation.pptx、slides.pdf、script.md、calculations.xlsx、event-clip.mp4、evidence-index.csv、playback-check.md 七件齐全，且 pptx 能被 python-pptx 读出幻灯片。
gates.en: All seven deliverables exist and the PPTX is parseable.
gates.effect_zh: 全部判定记否，验收失败。

gates.zh: 包结构完整性代理（Linux 评测无 PowerPoint）：zip 完整、内容类型齐全、内部关系目标存在、XML 良构、python-pptx 可打开，且无非超链接外部关系。
gates.en: Package-integrity proxy for opening in PowerPoint without repair (zip, content types, relationships, well-formed XML, python-pptx opens, no external non-hyperlink relationships).
gates.effect_zh: G6 记 0；V07 记否；验收失败（连续分照常报告）。

gates.zh: 作弊/违规：访问评测隐藏文件、联网取材、以材料以外来源的数据或影像替换材料内容。
gates.en: Cheating / network use / hidden-file access / outside data or imagery.
gates.note: v2026-10-25: not enforced by the automated grader (checks.py / rubric_score.py); human audit only.

items.criterion_zh: 9–11 页、16:9，含标题页与结束页，无空分隔页。
items.criterion_en: 9-11 slides, 16:9, title+closing, no empty dividers.
items.verify: python-pptx: slide count, slide size ratio; every slide has >=1 fact-bearing element besides title.

items.criterion_zh: 每页标题都是完整论断（含谓语的判断句），不是话题标签。
items.criterion_en: Every title is a claim sentence.
items.verify: Reviewer reads titles; any noun-phrase title => NO.

items.criterion_zh: 叙事顺序为：事件与后果 → 设计阶段错误 → 物理失效机理 → 现场损伤被观察与解读的过程 → 可中断环节评估 → 回答与边界；不缺环节、不跳回、不重复。
items.criterion_en: Narrative order: event and consequences -> design-stage errors -> physical failure mechanism -> how the distress was observed and interpreted on site -> barrier assessment -> answer and limits; no stage missing, no jumping back, no repeated stage.
items.verify: Judge maps each slide to a stage; any stage missing, out of order or repeated => NO.

items.criterion_zh: 结束页用一句话直接回答问题，并列出至少两条证据不支持的结论（须有材料依据，不得新增材料外事实）。
items.criterion_en: Closing slide answers in one sentence and lists >=2 conclusions the evidence does not support.
items.verify: Reviewer; both 'not supported' items must be backed by the report.

items.criterion_zh: script.md 按 130–150 词/分钟加声明停顿与短片时长计算的时长区间与 11–13 分钟有交集；逐页声明时长之和落在该区间 ±10% 内；每页备注文字与讲稿该页一致。
items.criterion_en: script.md timed at 130-150 wpm plus declared pauses and the clip gives a range overlapping 11-13 min; the per-slide declared durations sum to within ±10% of that range; each slide's notes match its script section.
items.verify: checks.py n05(): word count of script sections (markup stripped), ffprobe clip duration, 'pause N s' marks; per-slide 'Duration' parse; notes vs script token overlap >=0.9 per slide.

items.criterion_zh: 为非专家听众解释以下全部术语：节点/界面剪力（冷缝处的水平剪力传递）、需求/容量比（D/C）、后张拉杆的张拉与卸张、冗余（单一传力路径）、probable cause 与 contributing 的区别。
items.criterion_en: Explains interface shear at cold joint, D/C ratio, PT tensioning/detensioning, redundancy, probable cause vs contributing.
items.verify: Reviewer; any one unexplained => NO.

items.criterion_zh: 全篇以一致视觉编码区分“调查机构确立的事实 / 机构分析判断 / 制作者推断”，且无任何一处把制作者推断或当事方说法标为机构结论。
items.criterion_en: Consistent coding of fact vs agency judgement vs own inference; no own inference or party statement labelled as agency finding.
items.verify: Reviewer audits every coded element against report wording.

items.criterion_zh: 所有正文 ≥20 pt（按继承字号与自动缩放后的实际字号计；图注/出处行除外）。
items.criterion_en: All body text >=20 pt as rendered (inherited sizes and autofit scaling included); captions/source lines excluded.
items.verify: checks.py: run size resolved run -> paragraph -> shape lstStyle -> layout/master placeholder -> master txStyles -> presentation defaultTextStyle, times normAutofit fontScale; body = body/object placeholders + each slide's main text box (>=20 words, not a source/caption line).

items.criterion_zh: 图注、出处行及其他所有文字 ≥12 pt（按继承字号与自动缩放后的实际字号计）。
items.criterion_en: Captions, source lines and all other text >=12 pt as rendered (inherited sizes and autofit included).
items.verify: checks.py: same size resolution as V01, every text run of every text shape.

items.criterion_zh: 任一页要点 ≤6 条。
items.criterion_en: <=6 bullets per slide.
items.verify: checks.py: bullet paragraphs (buChar/buAutoNum or body-placeholder default) summed over all non-title text frames of each slide.

items.criterion_zh: 每个原生图表坐标轴有标题与单位（kips、比值等），多系列有图例，数据标签与坐标轴刻度标签字号 ≥12 pt（PowerPoint 渲染为准）。
items.criterion_en: Every chart has axis titles with units, legend if multi-series, data and tick labels >=12 pt as rendered.
items.verify: checks.py v04(): chart XML: every non-deleted axis has title text, value-axis title has a unit token; multi-series charts have a legend; tick and shown data-label sizes from axis/dLbls txPr, else chartSpace txPr, else 10 pt (PowerPoint default) must be >=12 pt.

items.criterion_zh: 报告原图裁切到相关图块并保留图例/图号，原生标注准确指向所述部位（如 11/12 节点、裂缝位置）。
items.criterion_en: Report figures cropped legibly; native callouts point at the right feature.
items.verify: Reviewer compares crop with source page.

items.criterion_zh: 静态渲染中无文字溢出或裁切，无对象超出页面，常显对象之间无重叠；带进入动画或触发效果的形状不参与重叠判定。
items.criterion_en: In the static render no text overflows or is clipped, nothing extends beyond the slide, and no always-visible objects overlap; shapes that carry entrance animations or trigger effects are excluded from the overlap test.
items.verify: checks.py fails shapes beyond the slide and overlapping always-visible text shapes (fail-only); judge checks text overflow/clipping on the rendered pages.

items.criterion_zh: 任何触发说明框、机理形状或标注显示时，不遮挡时间线条目（触发形状）、连接线、图表/表格框、视频或常显文字；不同触发器的说明框可共用同一位置。
items.criterion_en: No trigger panel, mechanism shape or callout, when revealed, covers a timeline entry (trigger shape), a connector, a chart/table frame, the video or always-visible text; panels revealed by different triggers may share one position.
items.verify: checks.py v07(): bbox of every animated target vs trigger shapes, chart/table frames, video, always-visible text shapes (overlap >0.1 in) and connector paths not glued to the target.

items.criterion_zh: 全篇英文语法、拼写、单位与时间写法正确一致（kips、in²、ft、a.m./p.m. 或 24 小时制统一）。
items.criterion_en: English, units and time notation correct and consistent.
items.verify: Reviewer + spell check.

items.criterion_zh: 交代事件基本事实：日期与约时刻、地点（道路）、主跨长度与下落高度、被压车辆数，均与报告一致。
items.criterion_en: Basic facts (date/time, location, span length, fall height, vehicles crushed) match the report.
items.verify: answer-key K-BASIC.

items.criterion_zh: 伤亡计数按表 1 分人群、分严重程度给出且与摘要一致（死亡 6 = 工人 1 + 车内 5），不把送医人数当作受伤人数。
items.criterion_en: Casualties per Table 1 by group and severity; hospital-transport count not used as injury count.
items.verify: answer-key K-INJ.

items.criterion_zh: 按报告原文区分 probable cause、contributing 与 contributing to the severity（封路/停工），不改写成追责措辞、不把严重度因素说成坍塌原因。
items.criterion_en: Distinguishes probable cause, contributing and severity factors per verbatim wording.
items.verify: answer-key K-PC.

items.criterion_zh: 至少引用两条安全建议，写明编号与对象机构，且至少一条与所述可中断环节对应。
items.criterion_en: Cites >=2 recommendations with number and addressee; >=1 tied to a barrier discussed.
items.verify: answer-key K-REC.

items.criterion_zh: 时间线关键节点日期/时刻全部正确：2/24 开裂声与 11/12 处裂缝、3/10 落位后卸张、3/13“非安全问题”回复与再张拉建议、3/15 上午会议、坍塌。
items.criterion_en: Timeline anchors (Feb 24, Mar 10, Mar 13, Mar 15 meeting, collapse) correct.
items.verify: answer-key K-TIMELINE; any wrong date/time => NO.

items.criterion_zh: 说明报告排除的因素：混凝土与钢材材料不是因素、千斤顶工作正常（Findings 2、3）。
items.criterion_en: States materials and jack were excluded as factors.
items.verify: answer-key K-MAT.

items.criterion_zh: [隐藏·条件项] 若简报给出节点 1/2 界面剪力需求低估的百分比：要么给出正文的 49% 并注明出自报告正文（p.78/PDF 97），要么给出按表 6 模型 1（2,481）与表 F-1（1,368 kips）算得的约 45%（模型 1–4 为 44.7–46.3%）并注明这些出处；两者并列并指出不一致亦通过。把 49% 说成可由表 6/F-1 复现、或给出百分比而无出处判否。未给出该百分比视为通过。
items.criterion_en: [hidden, conditional] If the deck states a percentage for the node 1/2 interface-shear demand underestimate, it either gives the printed 49% attributed to the report text (p.78/PDF 97), or gives the table-based ~45% (Table 6 Model 1 2,481 vs Table F-1 1,368 kips; 44.7-46.3% over Models 1-4) with those sources; showing both with the discrepancy flagged also passes. Presenting 49% as reproduced from Table 6/F-1, or a percentage without a source, fails. No node 1/2 percentage = pass.
items.verify: answer-key H01-49pct; deck text/notes/calculations.xlsx. The instruction only requires page traceability, not detection of the internal discrepancy.

items.criterion_zh: [隐藏] 用表 F-3/F-4 或 p.72 的口径量化 11/12 节点容量高估（约 20–22%）；若出现“约 25%”，指明其为 Pc 中 1.25 荷载系数的效应而非容量比；不把两数当同一量。
items.criterion_en: [hidden] Capacity overestimate quantified on the table basis (~20-22%); 25% identified as the 1.25 load-factor effect, never conflated.
items.verify: answer-key H02-20vs25.

items.criterion_zh: [隐藏] 表述坍塌发生在再张拉进行过程中（并引千斤顶活塞伸出/正在张拉等物证）；若引用 p.38“紧随其后”的说法须指出与他处不一致；任何地方不说再张拉已完成。
items.criterion_en: [hidden] Collapse during restressing with physical evidence; p.38 'immediately after' flagged if used; never 'completed'.
items.verify: answer-key H03-timing.

items.criterion_zh: [隐藏] 卸张后裂缝变化的两种表述分别归属：设计方内部邮件“略有增长” vs 调查人员“明显发展”；不把“略有增长”当作已确立事实。
items.criterion_en: [hidden] 'grew slightly' (designer emails) vs 'significantly progressed' (investigators) attributed; former not stated as fact.
items.verify: answer-key H04-crack-growth.

items.criterion_zh: [隐藏] 解释为何 D/C 最高的是节点 1/2（2.15）而失效发生在 11/12（1.62）：至少给出报告所列两条原因（24 vs 42 英寸隔板、四根竖向套管/空洞、杆件 11 比杆件 2 浅）。
items.criterion_en: [hidden] Explains why 11/12 failed although 1/2 had the highest D/C, with >=2 report reasons.
items.verify: answer-key H05-why-11-12.

items.criterion_en: Slides 8 to the last (text, chart data, callouts, notes): nothing unsupported by, or contradicting, the answer key and the cited pages in evidence-index.csv; one instance fails.
items.verify: Judge checks slide text, table cells, chart data and notes against the answer key and evidence-index.csv (the judge has no copy of the report).

items.criterion_zh: 失效机理链环节齐全且顺序正确：需求低估 → 容量高估 → 11/12 界面配筋不足与空洞 → 拆模起开裂并持续发展 → 卸张加剧损伤 → 再张拉 → 节点界面剪切失效 → 单一传力路径丧失、整跨坍塌；每环按“机构事实/机构分析/制作者推断”编码，无材料外环节。
items.criterion_en: Mechanism chain complete and in order: demand underestimated -> capacity overestimated -> 11/12 interface under-reinforced with voids -> cracking from formwork removal onward, growing -> detensioning increased damage -> restressing -> interface shear failure at the 11/12 node -> loss of the single load path, span collapse; each link coded as agency fact / agency analysis / own inference; no link not in the report.
items.verify: Judge vs answer-key K-MECH.

items.criterion_zh: 不把再张拉（或千斤顶操作）说成 probable cause 或“没有再张拉就不会坍塌”；按报告将其定位为未经同行评审的设计变更/荷载操作（Finding 21），根因为设计计算错误。
items.criterion_en: Restressing not presented as probable cause or as sufficient counterfactual; positioned per Finding 21.
items.verify: Reviewer vs K-PC/K-MAT/K-MECH.

items.criterion_zh: calculations.xlsx 正确算出 11/12 节点 D/C：调查方核算约 1.62（1,835/1,130，与图 31 一致）与设计方自身数值约 0.71（978/1,369），注明各自来源，均为实时公式。
items.criterion_en: D/C at 11/12: ~1.62 (agency check) and ~0.71 (design values), sourced, live formulas.
items.verify: openpyxl formulas + answer-key K-DC-calc (±0.02).

items.criterion_zh: 三帧时间戳间隔计算正确（0.165 s、0.264 s，共 0.429 s），并记入 calculations.xlsx。
items.criterion_en: Still-to-still intervals computed correctly (0.165 s, 0.264 s; 0.429 s).
items.verify: openpyxl + K-DASHCAM.

items.criterion_zh: 可中断环节判定与材料一致：至少一个被材料支持为可能防止坍塌的环节（如独立同行评审核查全部节点力，Finding 18），封路/停工被正确表述为降低后果严重度而非防止结构失效，且至少一个看似防线被正确否定（如冷缝打毛也不足以提供足够容量，Finding 5）。
items.criterion_en: Barrier verdicts match the report: >=1 supported preventive barrier, road closure as severity-only, >=1 tempting barrier rejected.
items.verify: Reviewer vs K-BARRIERS.

items.criterion_zh: 不越界：不指认个人罪责，不把结论推广到材料未支持的“所有混凝土桁架桥”式普遍断言，不对报告未判定的事项（如若未卸张是否仍会坍塌）给出确定结论。
items.criterion_en: No individual blame, no unsupported generalisation, no definite verdict on questions the report leaves open.
items.verify: Reviewer.

items.criterion_zh: 配筋量表述正确：设计提供 8 根 7 号筋（4.8 in²），调查方核算应另加约 13 in²，并保留报告“仅示数量级”的限定。
items.criterion_en: Rebar: 4.8 in^2 provided, ~13 in^2 more needed, with the order-of-magnitude caveat.
items.verify: answer-key K-REBAR.

items.criterion_zh: 关于坍塌历时的表述与报告一致：0.429 s 只表述为三张静图之间的间隔，不说成测得的完整坍塌历时（报告称整个事件录像不足 2 秒）。
items.criterion_en: Collapse duration: 0.429 s presented only as interval between stills, not as measured full duration.
items.verify: Reviewer vs K-DASHCAM.

items.criterion_zh: slides.pdf 与 pptx 页数相同，内容对应。
items.criterion_en: slides.pdf matches deck.
items.verify: Page count + title text match.

items.criterion_zh: evidence-index.csv 列齐全（页号、元素、论断、印刷页、PDF 页、图表/章节号、变换），且每页至少一行。
items.criterion_en: evidence-index.csv has all columns and >=1 row per slide.
items.verify: csv parse.

items.criterion_zh: 演讲者备注每页非空；标明 AI 协助制作与来源署名，无背书暗示。
items.criterion_en: Notes on every slide; AI disclosure and source credit; no endorsement.
items.verify: python-pptx notes + text search.

items.criterion_zh: ≥2 个原生图表（chart part，非图片），各有内嵌（非链接）工作簿，含所绘数值、单位表头或单位单元格及页码。
items.criterion_en: >=2 native charts (chart parts, not pictures), each with an embedded (not linked) workbook that contains the plotted values, a unit header or unit cell, and a page reference.
items.verify: checks.py d04(): c:externalData -> ppt/embeddings/*.xlsx; numbers present; a string cell matching page/p./PDF; a unit header/cell ('Unit', 'kips', '(kips)', 'ratio', 'D/C', 's', '%' ...).

items.criterion_zh: 图表所绘每个数值均为报告数值（报告正文或图 31 印出的数据标签）或 calculations.xlsx 的计算结果；绘制表 6 需求值的图表须声明所用模型或统计方式；各图表嵌入工作簿包含所绘数值。
items.criterion_en: Every plotted value is a report value (report text, or the printed Fig. 31 data labels) or a calculations.xlsx result; charts plotting Table 6 demands declare the model or statistic used; each chart's embedded workbook contains the plotted values.
items.verify: checks.py d05(): chart caches vs numbers in pdftotext(input/report.pdf) + answer-key K-FIG31 + calculations.xlsx formula results (tolerance: 0.006 below 1.2, else min(1, 0.5%)); cache values must be present in the embedded workbook; Table 6 match requires model/maximum/envelope wording on the slide or chart title.

items.criterion_zh: ≥2 幅图片为报告真实原图（从 PDF 提取或裁切，非重绘），且每幅上至少放有一个原生可编辑标注。

items.criterion_zh: 机理链页：原生形状 + 连到形状的连接线（cxnSp），≥6 个单击进入效果按机理顺序揭示独立形状。

Slideshow execution is inferred from the XML (no PowerPoint on the grader).

items.criterion_zh: 时间线页：≥5 个带日期条目各自是交互触发器（InteractiveSequences，TriggerType=OnShapeClick，TriggerShape 为该条目），揭示独立可编辑说明框；放映中逐个点击确实触发，非超链接/跳页/主序列。
items.criterion_en: >=5 dated entries each with on-shape-click InteractiveSequence revealing a separate panel; works in slideshow.
items.verify: checks.py d08(): p:timing interactiveSeq with onClick trigger spid on >=5 shapes whose text has a date, each revealing (entr) a separate panel shape. Slideshow behaviour is inferred from the XML.

items.criterion_zh: 至少一个原生图表在放映中按系列或按类别逐步构建（图表动画的 ChartUnit/BuildLevel 为按系列/类别，非整体出现、非叠放图片）。

items.criterion_en: Clip H.264, 4-12 s, 1280x720 or 1920x1080; the same media embedded in the pptx (ppt/media, not linked) and started by a click (on-click trigger, main-sequence click, or the default click-to-play media node; never auto-start).

items.criterion_zh: 短片内容：只用报告坍塌过程静图（图 9–11），按时间顺序，画面时刻标签与报告时间戳一致，画面注明为静图序列，节奏为 1:1 或注明放慢倍数且相对误差 ≤10%。
items.criterion_en: Clip uses only Figs 9-11 in order, labels match stamps, 'stills' disclosed, pacing 1:1 or stated factor within 10%.
items.verify: checks.py d11() (fail-only): ffmpeg frame differences split the clip into held stills; each matched (OpenCV NCC >=0.55) against the report's embedded Fig 9/10/11 images; order must be exactly Fig 9 -> 10 -> 11; holds must keep 0.165 : 0.264 s within 10% and equal 1:1 or a slow-down factor stated in slide text/notes/script (+-10%). When it reaches the judge these parts have passed; the judge checks the on-frame time labels and the 'sequence of stills' disclosure on the contact sheet.

items.criterion_zh: 包内无任何外部关系（媒体、图片、图表数据、字体），且所有被引用部件均存在。
items.criterion_en: No external relationship of any kind (media, images, chart data, fonts) and every referenced part is present in the package.

items.criterion_en: Key numbers consistent across all artefacts.
